ndbb90625b3.headline: Mum working 50 hour weeks forced to use food banks to cope with soaring bills
ndbb90625b3.summary: A full-time working mother of three says she has been forced to use food banks to cope with soaring bills, illustrating the cost-of-living squeeze.
ndbb90625b3.why: Rising household energy and food costs weigh on consumer spending, a major driver of the UK economy and retail sales.

nbd6435e3cc.headline: UK food shop to increase by
nbd6435e3cc.summary: Annual shopping bills in the UK are set to rise by almost £200 as inflation pushes up grocery costs, according to new data. The figure points to continued pressure on household budgets.
nbd6435e3cc.why: Food inflation feeds into consumer spending power and the Bank of England's interest rate decisions, which affect UK assets.

n91b3278bc5.headline: CGI reports strong first quarter Fiscal 2022 results Accelerating revenue growth driving 12.9% EPS accretion year-over-year
n91b3278bc5.summary: CGI reported first-quarter fiscal 2022 revenue of $3.09 billion, up 2.4% year over year or 6.8% in constant currency, with accelerating growth driving 12.9% EPS accretion.
n91b3278bc5.why: CGI is a Montreal-based IT and business consulting company, and its quarterly results are a read-through on demand for outsourced technology services.

nd05a6ee30b.headline: GITFiC begins nationwide survey on AfCFTA, declaration of Accra as Africa’s commercial capital
nd05a6ee30b.summary: The Ghana International Trade Finance Conference has begun a nationwide survey on the African Continental Free Trade Area and a declaration of Accra as Africa's commercial capital.
nd05a6ee30b.why: The AfCFTA is a continent-wide trade agreement that aims to lower tariffs and expand intra-African commerce, affecting trade finance and market access.

n36cb917f65.headline: Reforming asset tax system is an 'enormous' task, says minister
n36cb917f65.summary: Tax minister Marnix van Rij told MPs that amending asset tax legislation after a court ruling that the system breaks EU law is an enormous task. He warned against deciding too quickly.
n36cb917f65.why: Asset tax rules affect wealth and investment income for Dutch households and investors, and court rulings can force structural changes to tax policy.

nb063c76908.headline: East of England housing value breaks £900bn barrier
nb063c76908.summary: The total value of UK homes hit a record £8.4 trillion in 2021, according to Savills research, with homes in the East of England valued at over £900 billion.
nb063c76908.why: Housing wealth affects household spending, mortgage lending and the outlook for the Bank of England's interest-rate decisions.

nb3c675eb89.headline: Fuel prices Feb 3 - 9: Unchanged across the board, says Finance Ministry
nb3c675eb89.summary: Retail prices of RON95 and RON97 petrol remain unchanged at RM2.05 and RM3.12 per litre from February 3 until February 9, the Finance Ministry said.
nb3c675eb89.why: Malaysia sets domestic fuel prices through weekly government adjustments, which affect inflation and transport costs.

n4c948d56ac.headline: CGI renews its Normal Course Issuer Bid
n4c948d56ac.summary: CGI's board has authorised renewal of its Normal Course Issuer Bid, a share buyback program listed on the TSX and NYSE.
n4c948d56ac.why: CGI is a Montreal-based IT and business consulting firm, and buyback programs can reduce its share count and support per-share earnings.

n11404f0a09.headline: Finance Ministry: RON97, RON95 and diesel prices unchanged
n11404f0a09.summary: The Finance Ministry said retail prices for RON97 and RON95 petrol and diesel will stay at RM3.12, RM2.05 and RM2.15 per litre for February.
n11404f0a09.why: Government-set fuel prices in Malaysia feed into transport costs and inflation, affecting consumer spending and fuel-related companies.

n7be00fd9e2.headline: OPEC and Russia keep promising to pump more oil. They're not delivering
n7be00fd9e2.summary: OPEC and 10 other major crude producers, including Russia, are producing less than they promised, according to a CNN Business report. Oil prices are near a seven-year high.
n7be00fd9e2.why: OPEC is a cartel of major oil producers that coordinates output, and Russia is a leading non-OPEC exporter. Their combined output decisions are a key driver of global crude prices.
n7be00fd9e2.why_moved: Producers are pumping less than the increases they promised, tightening supply and keeping oil prices high.

na92875d825.headline: Spike in energy prices expected as Ofgem brings forward price cap announcement
na92875d825.summary: Ofgem's announcement of the household energy price cap is being brought forward, with bills reportedly set to rise by around 50 from April. The government is reportedly considering intervention to limit costs.
na92875d825.why: Ofgem is the UK energy regulator that sets the price cap on household gas and electricity tariffs. Changes to the cap affect consumer inflation and energy suppliers' margins.

na1448f5872.headline: South Africa’s FSCA warns investors against using FTX and ByBit
na1448f5872.summary: South Africa's financial regulator has warned crypto investors against using the FTX and ByBit exchanges. The warning concerns the safety of using these platforms.
na1448f5872.why: The FSCA regulates financial services in South Africa, and its warnings shape how local investors approach crypto platforms. FTX collapsed in 2022, which has heightened regulatory scrutiny of offshore exchanges.

nf5b0d88046.headline: Goodbye freeze: fuel prices rise again and there is relief at service stations
nf5b0d88046.summary: The Argentine government authorized the first fuel price increase this year, with state company YPF implementing changes starting Wednesday.
nf5b0d88046.why: Fuel prices affect inflation, consumer spending, and production costs in Argentina, a key Latin American economy.

impacts.name: YPF
impacts.why: Fuel price increase affects YPF's revenue and profitability.

n67e8860abc.headline: PS5 sales hit 17.3m, but hampered by chip shortages
n67e8860abc.summary: Sony's latest earnings report shows 17.3 million PS5 consoles shipped, though sales are hampered by ongoing semiconductor supply constraints.
n67e8860abc.why: Sony is a major player in gaming and consumer electronics; chip shortages impact production and sales in the tech sector.

impacts.name: Sony
impacts.why: Chip shortages limit sales growth despite strong shipment numbers.

n30f14cb4e5.headline: Digital rupee can be exchanged for cash: PM
n30f14cb4e5.summary: At the Atmanirbha Arthavyavastha symposium, India's Prime Minister stated that the central bank digital currency, the digital rupee, will be exchangeable for cash and improve online payment security.
n30f14cb4e5.why: The digital rupee is India's central bank digital currency initiative, which could transform payments and financial inclusion in the country.

n5b94f4471d.headline: Sri Lanka gets urgent $500 million Indian loan to pay for oil - Times of India
n5b94f4471d.summary: Sri Lanka was granted a $500 million loan from India to finance urgent oil imports amid energy shortages and blackouts.
n5b94f4471d.why: External financing impacts energy supply stability and economic stability in Sri Lanka.

n8090790d0a.headline: Economy in deep hole; don
n8090790d0a.summary: Ghana's parliamentary member criticizes government for delaying IMF support amid economic challenges.
n8090790d0a.why: IMF support is crucial for Ghana's economic stability and debt management, impacting investor confidence and currency outlook.

n0ae042774c.headline: Economic pain threatens social and political chaos in Tunisia
n0ae042774c.summary: President Kais Saied plans to remake Tunisian politics with a new constitution amid economic challenges.
n0ae042774c.why: Tunisia's political and economic stability is crucial for regional security and investment climate in North Africa.

n4ff8cf17e3.headline: El Salvador defends use of Bitcoin as legal tender
n4ff8cf17e3.summary: El Salvador's government defends its Bitcoin adoption, rejecting IMF concerns over volatility.
n4ff8cf17e3.why: Bitcoin's legal status affects El Salvador's monetary policy and international financial relations.

n96e302fce3.headline: Stakeholders fear border closure may cripple economy
n96e302fce3.summary: Nigeria's land border closures are disrupting trade, affecting business operations and leading to job losses in the maritime industry.
n96e302fce3.why: Border closures can reduce trade flows, impacting Nigeria's economy and regional supply chains.

source.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

sources.name: The Guardian Nigeria News - Nigeria and World News

nc68f20ab5d.headline: Nigeria lost $4bn to oil thieves in 9 months, says Tony Elumelu
nc68f20ab5d.summary: Nigeria's oil sector lost $4 billion to theft in nine months, indicating significant revenue loss and economic impact.
nc68f20ab5d.why: Oil theft affects Nigeria's revenue, foreign exchange reserves, and economic stability.

n04b16d1ff8.headline: UAE intercepts and destroys 3 'hostile' drones
n04b16d1ff8.summary: The UAE's defense intercepted and destroyed three drones, with unclear origin and potential security implications.
n04b16d1ff8.why: Drone incursions can threaten regional stability and impact investor confidence in the UAE.

nbe311135c1.headline: Exclusive: Logistics Startup Ecom Express To Raise INR 4,860 Cr Via IPO
nbe311135c1.summary: Logistics startup Ecom Express plans to raise INR 4,860 crore through an IPO, with a fresh issue and offer-for-sale by existing shareholders.
nbe311135c1.why: The IPO will provide capital for expansion in India's logistics sector, which is vital for e-commerce growth.

n72af4385c0.headline: India says it will launch digital rupee as soon as this year
n72af4385c0.summary: India plans to introduce a digital version of the rupee within the current year to modernize its monetary system.
n72af4385c0.why: The digital rupee could impact monetary policy, banking, and currency markets in India.

n9874f8aeb3.headline: Sri Lanka food inflation hits record 25pc as shortages bite
n9874f8aeb3.summary: Food inflation in Sri Lanka reached a record 25% due to crop failures and import financing issues, exacerbating economic crisis.
n9874f8aeb3.why: High inflation and shortages threaten economic stability, affecting consumer purchasing power and investor confidence.

n2560847a29.headline: USAID launches new US$10 million activity to strengthen youth workforce development and entrepreneurship in Uzbekistan
n2560847a29.summary: USAID introduces a five-year, US$10 million initiative to develop youth workforce skills and entrepreneurship in Uzbekistan.
n2560847a29.why: International development programs influence local employment, economic growth, and regional stability.

nbf62a36105.headline: £200 energy bill increase risks financial problems for one in four homes
nbf62a36105.summary: A £200 rise in energy bills could cause financial difficulties for a quarter of homes, according to regulators.
nbf62a36105.why: Rising energy costs directly affect household budgets, consumer spending, and can influence energy policy debates.

n5c179db717.headline: Bilfinger to support Rock Tech Lithium on its construction of Europe
n5c179db717.summary: Bilfinger signs an agreement to support Rock Tech Lithium as EPCM contractor for its European lithium project.
n5c179db717.why: Support for lithium project construction impacts the supply chain for EV batteries and the European green tech sector.

n70e3533471.headline: GlaxoSmithKline Says Gilead, ViiV Healthcare Settle Patent Dispute Over HIV Drug
n70e3533471.summary: GSK announced settlement of patent litigation with ViiV Healthcare and Gilead over HIV drugs, resolving a legal dispute in the pharmaceutical sector.
n70e3533471.why: Patent disputes can impact drug availability, pricing, and company valuations in the biotech industry.

nb7275968da.headline: There is a way to limit Brexit damage – rejoin the single market | Letters
nb7275968da.summary: Letters suggest rejoining the EU's single market or EEA to mitigate economic decline caused by Brexit.
nb7275968da.why: Reintegration into the single market could influence trade, investment, and economic growth prospects for the UK.

ncdfc7b393b.headline: Pakistan: Khan's China visit highlights Beijing reliance
ncdfc7b393b.summary: Imran Khan's visit to China highlights Pakistan's growing dependence on Chinese financial support, amid ongoing economic challenges.
ncdfc7b393b.why: China's loans and investments are significant for Pakistan's infrastructure and debt sustainability, affecting regional stability.

nf00ac84237.headline: India arrests police officer over crypto kidnap plot
nf00ac84237.summary: An Indian police officer and seven others were arrested for kidnapping a crypto trader who had amassed a $40 million fortune.
nf00ac84237.why: Criminal incidents involving crypto assets highlight regulatory and security challenges in the rapidly evolving digital asset space.
